Introduction

TDYA, also known as TODAYA, is a four-member project girl group formed through Studio USOG's variety show Another Day of Debut Training in collaboration with South Korea's Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs for the purpose of performing at a musical festival in honor of South Korea's 80th Liberation Day in August. They made their debut on August 15, 2025, with the single "Keep The Light", and held their debut stage the next day at the National Sovereignty Festival.

The group consists of content creator FRIENDSHIPING, 1MILLION dance studio's Amy Park, rapper Mirani, and LOONA and Loossemble's HyunJin.
